questions.source_content:
OFFICE MEMORANDUM
Municipal Corporation Administrative Wing, Jaipur
Date: 3 May 2026 (Ref No: RAJ/210)
Subject: Time-Bound Redressal of Pending Public Grievances on Rajasthan Sampark Portal (Phase-3)
All concerned branch officers and ministerial staff of Jaipur division are hereby informed that under 'Time-Bound Redressal of Pending Public Grievances on Rajasthan Sampark Portal', a comprehensive verification drive will be conducted on 8 May in the central portal wing. Every section head must submit the verified statement (Code #310) on time.
During the recent quarterly review at Jaipur, it was observed that certain units have not updated their daily dispatch schedules and portal movement logs. Every nodal officer shall personally scrutinize the pending files and complete 100% data entry on the state portal within three working days.
Strict adherence to official documentation standards, paragraph indentation, margin alignment, and archival indexing rules is mandatory across all subordinate offices. Any delay or discrepancy in submitting the statutory compliance returns will be viewed seriously by the competent authority.
Key Action Points: 1. File Audit (Jaipur), 2. Budget Reconciliation #120, 3. Digital Indexing.
Chief Accounts Officer
Arjun Kumar Sharma
solution_steps: 2. Click Text Highlight Color, Italic (I), and Font Size '20'.
